rationale.conceptual: The method involves well-established DFT-GGA calculations of adsorption energies and diffusion barriers; no novel algorithms or derivations. The required understanding is at the level of standard computational materials science.
rationale.execution: Reproducing the paper requires numerous DFT calculations (geometry optimizations for multiple Li configurations, NEB for several diffusion paths) and careful energy extraction, forming a multi-stage pipeline with many interdependent steps.

difficulty.reasoning: Standard DFT adsorption/diffusion calculations on a known nanoribbon system. Non-trivial pipeline of many relaxations and NEB paths, but conceptually straightforward.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small simulation cells (<100 atoms) with standard pseudopotentials; memory per DFT run ~few GB; no large datasets.
